pages.title: Come Over Here
pages.text: Relocate an eligible bound target while preserving native world restrictions.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Sneak-right-click a target with Soul Pearl, then throw it. Summoner Pearl instead relocates nearby targets at impact. Both retain native exclusions and server teleport rules.
